in_hebrew.name: Arty
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Arty הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'artios', meaning 'complete' or 'perfect'. In ancient Greece, 'artios' was used to describe someone who was 'complete' in character and actions. In Christian context, Arty represents a noble and virtuous person.
